# Basemap data

`world-land.geojson` is Natural Earth's 1:110m land geometry, downloaded from the project's [source repository](https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson).

Natural Earth data is [public domain](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/). The bundled 138 KB geometry provides a local low-detail basemap when external satellite/street tiles are unavailable. It is not live imagery, a political boundary dataset, GeoIP enrichment or log evidence.
